title: TradingView Visual Oracle — canonical parity contract (v1.0.0)
description: Machine-readable statement of every production behaviour the Pine oracle must mirror, extracted from the DEPLOYED engine by tools/oracle/extract_contract.py. Regenerated, never hand-edited: `python -m tools.oracle.extract_contract --write`. Validated by backend/tests/test_oracle_contract.py. The contract is derived state — if it disagrees with production, production is right and the contract is stale.

inputs.description: Exactly the fields hashed. end_date is deliberately absent — it is the one live delta and advances daily.

canonical_payload.description: The sorted compact JSON that was hashed. Recorded so a mismatch can be diagnosed without re-running the tool.

engine_version.description: Lux 3-file digest. Insufficient alone — covers 3 of ~23 production modules.

governed_files.description: Per-file digests — the basis of `tools/oracle/impact.py --vs-contract`, which needs no git.

pin_verified.description: MUST be true for any released build.

pine_relevant.description: Grouped as the oracle consumes them.

missing_expected_fields.description: MUST be empty. A non-empty list means the engine dropped a field the oracle depends on — extraction fails with exit 3.

unsupported_active_features.description: MUST be empty. Non-empty means a production mechanism the oracle does not implement is ACTIVE — extraction fails with exit 4 and the oracle is INCOMPATIBLE, not merely stale.

day_boundary.description: UTC calendar day — NOT the exchange session (limitation L-06).

addressable_cells.description: Populated cells = cohorts + state_override cells + eligibility_state cells.

items.description: Pine encodes effective_regime. deployed_regime is shown alongside so the include-disabled override is visible rather than silent.

live_only_config_deltas.description: Config fields the live runner overrides per cycle and which are therefore excluded from oracle identity.

enums.description: Every production enum / reason code Pine must handle. Generation FAILS if any value lacks a Pine mapping.

source.description: live = imported from the running engine; scan = parsed from pinned source; manual = hand-maintained and drift-tested. `manual` must not appear for behavioural values.

origin.description: Exact symbol or file the values came from.

oracle_status_extensions.description: Statuses the ORACLE adds because the driver vocabulary does not cover them. Each carries its justification. This is a declared divergence, not a licence to invent labels.

oracle_only_enums.description: Oracle-side vocabularies with no production source.

manual_behavioural_values.description: MUST be 0. Every behavioural value is machine-extracted; hand-maintained behaviour is how a parity contract rots.
